build_prompts_textbook_academic: build prompts from web extracts using the textbook_academic style for a HuggingFace dataset
build_prompts_all_styles: build prompts from web extracts using all four generation styles and push to hub
build_prompt_function: build a prompt by inserting a web extract and topic into a styled template
run_cli_textbook: run the CLI to load textbook data and generate textbook_academic style prompts
review_styles_dict: review the STYLES dictionary containing wikihow, textbook_narrative, textbook_academic, and blogpost prompt templates
